column1: # Interface defaults: the client-side variables a character is handed on its
# very first login, before it has any saved state of its own.
# columns: kind<TAB>id<TAB>value      kind is varc | varcbit | varcstr
# 240 entries: 92 varc, 100 varcbit, 48 varcstr. Sent only to a character whose
# PlayerSave.varcs is empty; from then on the character's own settings win.
# Treat this as a starting layout that is known to produce a working HUD, not as
# a specification of the client's own defaults. It contains interface state only
# -- panel positions, tab selections, HUD arrangement -- and no player data.
